source_proof.proof: For valid unit token states rho_t=|psi_t><psi_t|, unit query phi, eps>0, set A_t=rho_t+eps I8 and B=sum_valid A_t. Then B is positive definite. Set M_t=B^-1/2 A_t B^-1/2, so M_t>=0 and sum M_t=I8. Set chi_phi=B^1/2 phi/sqrt(phi^dagger B phi). Source alpha_t=(Tr(P_phi rho_t)+eps)/(sum_valid Tr(P_phi rho_t)+T eps)=<chi_phi|M_t|chi_phi>. This is an equivalent token-index POVM representation, not a new learned40label POVM or model modification. Measurement contracts trace distance, giving TV(alpha_phi,alpha_psi)<=sqrt(1-|phi^dagger B psi|^2/((phi^dagger B phi)(psi^dagger B psi))). One proof takes the sum of M_t over the positive probability-difference event as an effect0<=E<=I; its expectation difference is bounded by the trace distance of the two pure states, whose two nonzero eigenvalues are +/-sqrt(1-fidelity). For fixed arbitrary real utilities u_rt and query reassignment pi(r), |z'_r-z_r|<=osc(u_r)*TV(alpha_r,alpha_pi(r))=:delta_r by TV duality. Thus all40decisions are unchanged if each original winning margin z_y-z_r>delta_y+delta_r. For any fixed true target y, CE(z',y)<=log(1+sum_{r!=y}exp(z_r-z_y+delta_r+delta_y)). No positivity, common utility or shared bias restriction is imposed on this general bound; no Macro-F1 or gain guarantee follows. These are known operator/data-processing/TV tools, not newL5theory. Identities are in exact arithmetic; finite native norms and reductions need explicit residual checks, not bitwise equivalence assumptions.

exact_math.conclusion: The same fixed nearly identical queries yield TV0 or TV>.99 in two contexts. Raw query overlap alone does not establish attention collapse or harmful task crosstalk.
exact_math.source_identity: A_t=rho_t+eps I; B=sum_t A_t; M_t=B^-1/2 A_t B^-1/2; chi=B^1/2 phi/sqrt(phi^dagger B phi). Alpha=chi^dagger M_t chi, sum_t M_t=I.
exact_math.proven_bound: TV(alpha(phi),alpha(psi)) <= sqrt(1-|phi^dagger B psi|^2/(phi^dagger B phi psi^dagger B psi)). For fixed utilities: abs(logit(querychange)) <= utility_range*TV. Full40 margin certificate and CE upper bound follow coordinatewise.
